template_description: Manual semantic segment annotations for a simulated robot pants-folding episode.

task.name: simulated robot pants folding
task.description: A simulated dual-arm robot folds a pair of pants and then returns toward its reset configuration.
task.annotation_scope: episode_000033, using the top RGB video as the annotation timeline

frame_indexing.note: Use zero-based decoded-video frame indices. Each segment is represented by [start_frame, end_frame_exclusive), and end_frame_inclusive equals end_frame_exclusive - 1.

annotation_guidance.segments: Segments are non-overlapping and in temporal order. Each segment uses [start_frame, end_frame_exclusive), with end_frame_inclusive = end_frame_exclusive - 1 and num_frames = end_frame_exclusive - start_frame.
annotation_guidance.coverage: The segments cover every decoded frame from 0 through 268 without gaps or overlaps.
annotation_guidance.dtw: Top-camera frame k corresponds to row k of embeddings and embeddings_l2 in the referenced DINOv3 NPZ file.
annotation_guidance.multi_view: The top, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos share the same 30 FPS episode timeline. Segment boundaries are defined on the top-camera timeline.

segment_schema.label: task-specific string included in labels
segment_schema.notes: brief semantic description of the segment

segments.label: Reach top pant half
segments.notes: The robot reaches toward the upper half of the pants.

segments.label: Grasp top pant half
segments.notes: The robot establishes its grasp on the upper half of the pants.

segments.label: Fold top pant half
segments.notes: The robot folds the upper half of the pants.

segments.label: Ungrasp top pant half
segments.notes: The robot releases its grasp after folding the upper half.

segments.label: Reach pant end
segments.notes: The robot reaches toward the end of the pants.

segments.label: Grasp pant end
segments.notes: The robot establishes its grasp on the end of the pants.

segments.label: Fold pant end
segments.notes: The robot folds the end of the pants.

segments.label: Ungrasp pant end
segments.notes: The robot releases the end of the pants after completing the fold.

segments.label: Reset
segments.notes: The robot returns toward its reset configuration after releasing the folded pants.
